## Highlights

**Kraftverk 0.2.1** adds hard **AMD-exclusive** hardware enforcement (`amd-only-v1`) across CLI, desktop, SDK, agent, and optimizer ΓÇö plus Windows GPU ClassGUID detection polish. Builds on the 0.2.0 platform phase (KraftBench v2, optimizer sessions/profiles, desktop instrument, SDK).

Independent product: not affiliated with or endorsed by AMD.

## What's included

- **CLI** (`kraftverk` / `kraftverk.exe`) ΓÇö inspect, baseline, optimize, report, profiles, doctor, and more
- **Desktop** (`kraftverk-desktop` / `kraftverk-desktop.exe`) ΓÇö local web UI + hardware blocker
- **AMD gate** ΓÇö CPUID + PCI vendor checks; policy `amd-only-v1` on experiments/fingerprints
- **Inspect-only commands** ΓÇö `compatibility`, `hardware`, `amd cpu|gpu` (no eligibility gate)
- **Exit codes 20ΓÇô25** for unsupported architecture / Intel CPU / NVIDIA GPU / Intel GPU / unknown / mixed
- **Hot-plug NVIDIA abort** ΓÇö stop experiments, restore managed config, block further work
- **KraftBench v2** ΓÇö CPU scaling, compile proxy, responsiveness, sustained windows
- **Optimizer** ΓÇö goals, constraints, sessions/resume, lineage, insights, evidence receipts
- **SDK** ΓÇö `Kraftverk::open_default()` fails with `UnsupportedHardware` on ineligible hosts
- Packaged archives include `README.md`, `LICENSE`, and `CHANGELOG.md`

## Install

### Windows (x86_64)

1. Download [`kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.1/kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip)
2. Verify checksum against [`kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.1/kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256):

   ```powershell
   Get-FileHash .\kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip -Algorithm SHA256
   Get-Content .\kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256
   ```

3. Extract the zip. Run CLI or desktop from the extracted folder:

   ```powershell
   .\kraftverk.exe compatibility
   .\kraftverk-desktop.exe
   ```

   Loose binaries (`kraftverk.exe`, `kraftverk-desktop.exe`) are also attached to this release if you prefer not to use the archive.

### Linux (x86_64)

1. Download [`kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.1/kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz)
2. Verify checksum against [`kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.1/kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256):

   ```bash
   sha256sum -c kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256
   ```

3. Extract and run:

   ```bash
   tar xzf kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
   cd kraftverk-v0.2.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
   chmod +x kraftverk kraftverk-desktop
   ./kraftverk compatibility
   ./kraftverk-desktop
   ```

### Build from source

```bash
cargo build --release -p kraftverk-cli
cargo build --release -p kraftverk-desktop
```

## Quick start

```bash
kraftverk compatibility
kraftverk hardware
kraftverk inspect
kraftverk baseline
kraftverk optimize --mode safe --goal balanced
kraftverk status
kraftverk report --format html
kraftverk restore --baseline
```

Desktop (same local DB):

```bash
kraftverk-desktop
```

## Hardware requirements

| Check | Rule |
|-------|------|
| Architecture | **x86 / x86_64** only |
| CPU | **AMD** (`AuthenticAMD`) |
| GPU | None OK; if present, **AMD only** (PCI `0x1002`) |
| Blocked | Intel CPU; NVIDIA / Intel GPU; mixed / unknown vendors |

Exit codes **20ΓÇô25**. No production `--force` bypass.

Full policy: [Hardware support](https://theworker02.github.io/kraftverk/docs/hardware-support.html) ┬╖ [docs/hardware-support.md](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/blob/v0.2.1/docs/hardware-support.md)

## Known limitations

- GPU benchmarks unsupported (no vendor backend)
- Temperature / power sensors unavailable portably
- Privileged agent remains a scaffold
- Desktop is a **local web UI** (Tauri packaging later)
- ╬╡-greedy / Bayesian search plugins listed but not implemented
